title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting transition still executes the unguarded UPDATE — the taken_over_at backstop is unwired and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1250-1256: `sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)` — update_reference_call_status.sql: `WHERE id = $1` `  AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause). `grep -rn mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person`: only sql.gleam:1891 + the integration test:1746,1758 (`rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)`) — the handler never calls it. The test drives the SQL directly, not the POST route.
detail: Both mandate conditions fail: the executed wrong-person UPDATE has no taken_over_at IS NULL backstop (a take-over racing the POST still matches status=contact_initiated — take-over never changes status), and the race test calls the guarded SQL function directly while the handler uses a different UPDATE — neutralizing the backstop would not catch the unwired path.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person (replace the update_reference_call_status call); rewrite the race pin to drive handle_wrong_person_post and assert 0-row stand-down against a taken-over row.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): Escape-to-close is still wired to the menu div — a sibling of the focused ⋯ button, so click-then-Escape still does nothing
location: client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:745-748 (keydown on the menu div); no Escape test in client/test
evidence: reference_panel.gleam:744-748: `True ->` `html.div([attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-menu-" <> slot), attribute("role", "menu"), // r2 (N14): Escape closes the menu (the confirm_modal pattern). event.on("keydown", menu_escape_decoder(...))` — the handler sits on the menu div, which is a sibling of the ⋯ button (focus stays on the button after click); no autofocus/tabindex moves focus into the menu. `grep keydown|Escape` in client tests: no pin.
detail: Keydown dispatched on the focused ⋯ button bubbles through its ancestors, never through the sibling menu div — the handler is unreachable in the natural flow the r3 finding described.
recommended_fix: Move the keydown handler onto the ⋯ button (fires while the menu is open), or autofocus the first menuitem; add a component test for click-then-Escape.
